Unmerged low-rank arithmetic is not bit-identical to merging then requantizing; any eventual merged quantized artifact must be checked in its own final runtime, against the accepted W8 baseline/candidate as appropriate.

evidence.claim: CT pack-quantized integer weight-only group/channel schemes select CompressedTensorsWNA16MoEMethod and dense CompressedTensorsWNA16; 8-bit maps to uint8b128.
CT MoE requests allow_tile_padding=True and sets up internal modular MoE kernel. INT8 uses kInt8StaticGroupScale; Marlin accepts this quant key. Group32 and channel(-1) are supported.

MarlinExperts inherits LoRAExpertsMixin and injects w13 LoRA before activation and w2 LoRA before final MoE sum. Device minimum SM75 permits RTX3090 SM86. Ordinary TP2 and Gemma4 gelu activation pass inspected gates.

Hidden2816 is divisible128. Gemma4 expert intermediate704 / TP2 =352; Marlin pads352 to384. Group32 divides352 and shared-MLP partition1056; group64/128 do not and cannot be repaired across TP scale boundaries.

The installed non-fully-sharded one-shot and small-batch LoRA wrappers derive K from A0.shape[3], while honoring the activation row stride. Thus down-A352 consumes first352 lanes of padded384 activation. CPU intercepted-launch probe confirms these exact arguments.

Keep fully_sharded_loras=false. Legacy fully-sharded path derives K from padded input shape, which differs from logical LoRA A. Current adapters have zero gate/up factors, making their logical slice offset352 harmless even though base packed output gate/up halves are384 wide. Nonzero gate/up LoRA is outside this audited contract.

Global linear backend marlin does not force ignored BF16 linears into an INT8 kernel: unquantized dispatch falls back to ordinary GEMM. For compressed-tensors Gemma4 passes quant config to vision; explicit vision/embed ignore rules are required and present in exporter recipe.
Installed CLI explicitly defines --linear-backend and --moe-backend, with marlin choices; LoRA bool defaults false and BooleanOptionalAction provides the explicit negative flags.
